scripts.encrypt:work: bash -c 'for file in _site/work.html $(find _site/work -name "*.html" -type f); do npx staticrypt "$file" -d "$(dirname "$file")" -p "${STATICRYPT_PASSWORD:-my portfolio work}" -l "View Work"; done'
scripts.dev: npm run prettier:check && npm run watch:css & eleventy --serve
scripts.dev:encrypted: npm run prettier:check && npm run watch:css & ./encrypt-watch.sh & eleventy --serve
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:css && npm run build:eleventy && npm run encrypt:work && rsync -av _site/ encrypted/
